name: print-social-indigo-discover-your-potential-banner-with-green-cta-and-duotone-photo
title: Indigo Discover Your Potential Banner
whatItIs: An indigo banner template with a dark navy panel holding a green logo, the headline 'Discover Your Potential With Us.', a paragraph and a green GET IN TOUCH NOW button beside a faint large letter shape, over a violet-tinted photo strip of people working at computers.
whatItMeans: A duotone photo in the brand violet keeps imagery on-palette, and the green button is the sole contrast.
techniques: Duotone photo tinted to the brand colour
Oversized ghost logo shape in the panel
Panel and photo stacked as two zones
Light headline with a smaller paragraph

vocabulary.definition: A photo tinted in one hue range.
A large faint logo shape used as a background.
A banner divided into a text zone and an image zone.
